passages.title: 사보 기고 요청 메일
passages.passage:
From: Internal Communications
To: Ravi Menon, Senior Engineer
Subject: Would You Write for the Company Magazine?

Dear Ravi,

The next issue of our quarterly magazine focuses on 'projects that almost failed' — honest stories about recoveries, not just victories. Your bridge sensor project came up repeatedly when we asked around: three missed deadlines, a supplier collapse, and still a successful launch that customers now praise.

Would you write 800 to 1,000 words on what went wrong and what turned it around? We want the real story, including the uncomfortable parts — our most-read article ever was an engineer describing a failed product test.

The deadline is the 25th, and our editor will help polish the draft, so please don't worry about writing style. Authors receive a small gift, and more importantly, these stories genuinely help junior colleagues feel safer admitting problems early.

May I count you in?

Selin Kaya, Internal Communications

questions.q: What is the magazine issue's theme?
choices: Projects that almost failed and recovered
questions.exKo: 실패 직전까지 갔다가 회복한 프로젝트의 솔직한 이야기가 주제입니다.

questions.q: Why should Ravi not worry about writing quality?
choices: An editor will help polish the draft
questions.exKo: 편집자가 원고를 다듬어 주므로 문체 걱정은 필요 없습니다.

questions.q: What broader benefit do such stories provide?
choices: Juniors feel safer admitting problems early
questions.exKo: 후배들이 문제를 일찍 인정하는 것을 두려워하지 않게 돕습니다.

passages.title: 단골 고객 감사 프로그램 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: Orchard Office Supplies
To: Valued Business Customers
Subject: You Asked, We Built It — Introducing Orchard Priority

Dear Customer,

After 40 interviews with our longest-standing business clients, we heard three wishes again and again: faster reordering, predictable delivery windows, and a human who knows your account. Orchard Priority, launching next month, delivers all three — free for any business ordering over $500 monthly.

Priority members get one-click reordering from purchase history, guaranteed two-hour delivery windows you choose at checkout, and a named account contact reachable by direct line until 8 p.m. We are also adding a quarterly usage report that flags cheaper alternatives for your most-ordered items — yes, we will occasionally talk you into spending less. Loyalty should run both directions.

Your account qualifies automatically; nothing to sign. Your contact, Maria Duarte, will call this week to introduce herself.

Thank you for eleven years of business.

Tom Orchard, Founder

questions.q: How was the program designed?
questions.exKo: 오랜 고객 40곳 인터뷰에서 나온 세 가지 요청을 반영해 만들었습니다.

questions.q: What does the usage report do?
choices: Flags cheaper alternatives for frequent items
questions.exKo: 자주 주문하는 품목의 더 저렴한 대안을 알려 줍니다.

questions.q: What does 'Loyalty should run both directions' suggest?
choices: The company should also act in customers' interest
questions.exKo: 고객에게 돈을 덜 쓰게 권하더라도 회사도 신의로 보답한다는 뜻입니다.

passages.title: 다과실 무인 판매대 정직 운영 공지
passages.passage:
HONOR MARKET — HOW IT'S GOING

Six months ago we replaced the vending machines with the unstaffed Honor Market: take what you need, scan and pay at the kiosk. Time for a report.

The numbers: payment accuracy runs at 97 percent — better than we hoped, and the small gap is mostly forgotten scans rather than intent, based on camera-free shelf counts. Sales are double the vending machines', and the fresh food option means the fridge empties daily.

What changes: the sandwich shelf grows, card-only payment ends — the kiosk now takes phone pay — and we are adding a 'pay it forward' button that buys a coffee credit for a colleague, anonymous by design.

One request: the market works because we trust each other, and 3 percent is the price of not searching bags. If you notice you forgot to scan, just scan twice next time. Nobody is watching; that is the point.

Workplace Committee

questions.q: What explains most of the 3 percent payment gap?
questions.exKo: 고의가 아니라 스캔을 잊은 경우가 대부분으로 파악됩니다.

questions.q: What payment change is coming?
questions.exKo: 카드 전용에서 휴대폰 결제 추가로 바뀝니다.

questions.q: What is the suggested remedy for a forgotten scan?
questions.exKo: 다음에 두 번 스캔하면 된다고 안내합니다.

passages.title: 장비 대여 라이브러리 운영 공지
passages.passage:
EQUIPMENT LIBRARY — BORROW, DON'T BUY

Before your team buys another projector that gets used twice a year, check the Equipment Library on floor 2. The library stocks items teams need occasionally but not constantly: portable projectors, presentation clickers, video kits, label printers, measurement tools, and six loaner laptops configured for guest use.

Borrowing works like a book library: reserve online, pick up with your badge, return by the due date. Standard loans run one week, renewable twice unless someone is waiting. Popular items around quarter-end — projectors especially — should be reserved two weeks ahead.

The library saved teams an estimated $180,000 in avoided purchases last year. Suggest new items through the portal; anything requested by three or more teams gets evaluated at the monthly review. Broken or missing items should be reported immediately — no blame, we just need to know.

Asset Management

questions.q: What kind of items does the library stock?
questions.exKo: 가끔 필요하지만 상시 쓰지는 않는 장비를 갖추고 있습니다.

questions.q: When can a loan NOT be renewed?
choices: When someone is waiting for the item
questions.exKo: 대기자가 있으면 갱신할 수 없습니다.

questions.q: How do new items get added?
choices: Requests from three or more teams get evaluated
questions.exKo: 세 팀 이상이 요청한 품목은 월례 검토에서 평가됩니다.

passages.title: 중소기업 IT 관리 대행 광고
passages.passage:
TECHGUARD — YOUR IT DEPARTMENT, WITHOUT THE DEPARTMENT

At 30 employees, you need real IT — but not a full-time hire. TechGuard manages laptops, accounts, security, and support for growing companies at a flat per-person monthly rate.

New hire starting Monday? We ship a configured laptop to their door with accounts ready. Someone leaves? One click locks every access. Our monitoring patches machines overnight and blocks the phishing links your busiest people will absolutely click on a Friday afternoon.

Support answers in under four minutes by chat, and our engineers explain fixes in plain language — clients rate 'no jargon' as their favorite feature after 'it just works.' Quarterly reviews keep your setup ahead of your growth, not behind it.

From $45 per person monthly, 30-day exit clause, no hardware lock-in. The IT worry-free trial: techguard.io/start.

questions.q: Who is TechGuard designed for?
choices: Growing companies too small for full-time IT
questions.exKo: 전담 IT 인력을 두기엔 작은 성장기 기업이 대상입니다.

questions.q: What happens when an employee leaves?
questions.exKo: 클릭 한 번으로 모든 접근 권한이 잠깁니다.

questions.q: What do clients like second best after reliability?
questions.exKo: 전문용어 없는 설명이 '그냥 잘 된다' 다음으로 좋아하는 특징입니다.

passages.title: 재활용 굿즈 제작 업체 광고
passages.passage:
LOOPMADE — MERCH YOUR CUSTOMERS WON'T THROW AWAY

Branded pens end up in drawers; branded landfill ends up in headlines. LoopMade makes promotional goods people actually keep — notebooks from coffee-cup paper, totes from banner vinyl, desk organizers from ocean-bound plastic.

Every item carries a scannable tag telling its material story — where the waste came from, what it became — turning giveaways into brand storytelling. Clients report event booth visitors keeping LoopMade items at triple the rate of standard merch.

Minimums start at 250 units with three-week production; rush available. Your logo is applied with plant-based inks, and unavoidable offcuts return to our material stream — the loop in LoopMade is literal.

B-Corp certified, carbon accounting on every invoice. Order samples at loopmade.eco — the sample box itself becomes a desk tray. Naturally.

questions.q: What does the scannable tag show?
questions.exKo: 폐기물이 어디서 와서 무엇이 되었는지 소재 이력을 보여 줍니다.

questions.q: What result do clients report?
choices: Items kept at triple the rate of standard merch
questions.exKo: 일반 굿즈보다 3배 높은 비율로 방문객이 보관합니다.

questions.q: What is clever about the sample box?
choices: It converts into a desk tray
questions.exKo: 샘플 상자 자체가 책상 정리함으로 변신합니다.

passages.title: 사내 기술 자격 수당 경쟁 기사
passages.passage:
COMPENSATION TRENDS — Skill premiums are replacing annual raises as the retention tool of choice in technical industries, a salary survey of 12,000 workers indicates. Under these schemes, employees earn permanent pay increases — typically 3 to 8 percent — for certifying in specific skills their employer needs: cloud platforms, safety systems, additional languages.

The appeal for employers is precision: money flows to capabilities that fill actual gaps, rather than across-the-board increases. Workers like the control — "My raise doesn't depend on my manager's budget mood; it depends on me passing an exam," one respondent wrote.

Misfires happen: one utility offered a premium for a certification so difficult that nobody qualified for a year, and firms report 'certificate collecting' of skills never used. The fix, analysts say, is pairing premiums with rotation programs that put new skills to work within months — retention gains double when certified skills are actually exercised.

questions.q: What are skill premiums?
choices: Permanent raises for certifying in needed skills
questions.exKo: 회사가 필요로 하는 기술 인증 취득 시 지급되는 영구 임금 인상입니다.

questions.q: Why do workers like the system?
choices: Raises depend on their own exam results
questions.exKo: 인상이 관리자 재량이 아니라 본인의 시험 통과에 달려 있기 때문입니다.

questions.q: When do retention gains double?
choices: When certified skills are put to actual use
questions.exKo: 순환 프로그램으로 인증 기술을 실제 활용할 때 효과가 배가됩니다.

passages.title: 관광지 비수기 워케이션 유치 기사
passages.passage:
REGIONAL ECONOMY — Seaside town Port Aria has turned its empty winter season into a remote-work destination, tripling November-to-March visitor revenue in two years. The 'Work by the Water' program bundles what remote workers actually need: certified fast internet in 60 participating cafes and guesthouses, a co-working hall in the renovated ferry terminal, and month-long lodging rates at half the summer price.

The town verified every venue's internet speed and posts live desk availability online — reliability, organizers found, matters more to remote workers than scenery. Local businesses adapted: restaurants added lunch specials on weekdays, the gym introduced monthly passes, and the ferry company converted a warehouse into event space for the visiting companies' team weeks.

Average stay is 24 days, and a fifth of winter workers return within a year — three have opened permanent businesses in town. Neighboring towns have sent delegations to copy the model, which Port Aria's mayor encourages: "A remote-work coast helps every town on it."

questions.q: What did organizers find matters most to remote workers?
questions.exKo: 원격 근무자에게는 경치보다 인터넷 신뢰성이 중요했습니다.

questions.q: What sign of lasting impact does the article mention?
questions.exKo: 겨울 방문자 중 3명이 마을에 상시 사업체를 열었습니다.

questions.q: How does the mayor view neighboring towns copying the model?
choices: Positively — a remote-work region benefits everyone
questions.exKo: 원격근무 해안이 형성되면 모든 마을에 이롭다며 환영합니다.

passages.title: 고객사 요구 사양 변경 협의 문자
passages.passage:
Anya Sokolova (10:30 A.M.)
Heads-up: Delta Foods wants the jar labels waterproof now — their new filling line sprays mist. They asked if we can switch without moving the delivery date.

Ben Carter (10:34 A.M.)
Waterproof stock we have. But their label design uses a foil accent — foil plus waterproof coating needs a different press, and that press is booked solid this week.

Anya Sokolova (10:36 A.M.)
Options?

Ben Carter (10:38 A.M.)
A: drop the foil, keep the date. B: keep foil, deliver four days late. C: split — plain waterproof labels for their first production run now, foil version for the rest next week.

Anya Sokolova (10:40 A.M.)
I'll pitch C. Their line test only needs 5,000 labels anyway.

Ben Carter (10:52 A.M.)
Delta says yes to C. They called it 'the answer we hoped someone would think of.'

Anya Sokolova (10:53 A.M.)
Booking both runs now. Nice save, Ben.

questions.q: Why can't the full order switch immediately?
choices: Foil plus waterproofing needs a fully booked press
questions.exKo: 포일 장식과 방수 코팅을 함께 하려면 이번 주 예약이 꽉 찬 인쇄기가 필요합니다.

questions.q: What does option C involve?
choices: Plain waterproof labels first, foil version later
questions.exKo: 1차 생산분은 방수 무포일로 먼저, 나머지는 다음 주 포일 버전으로 나눠 납품합니다.

questions.q: Why does option C work for Delta?
choices: Their line test needs only a small quantity
questions.exKo: 라인 테스트에는 5,000장이면 충분해 우선 물량으로 해결됩니다.

passages.title: 연말 결산 야근 식사 지원 문자
passages.passage:
Priya Shah (5:45 P.M.)
Close week starts Monday. Finance will run late Tuesday through Thursday — can we set up meal support like last quarter?

Max Weber (5:48 P.M.)
Yes. Same setup? Dinner delivered 7 P.M. for whoever's still in, taxi vouchers after 10?

Priya Shah (5:50 P.M.)
Same, plus one change — last time everyone ordered individually and food arrived over 40 minutes. Let's do two group platters instead, one vegetarian.

Max Weber (5:52 P.M.)
Smarter. Headcount?

Priya Shah (5:53 P.M.)
Twelve Tuesday, likely eight Wednesday, four or five Thursday. I'll confirm each day by 3 P.M.

Max Weber (5:55 P.M.)
Booked. And HR asked me to remind managers: close week doesn't waive the rest rules — anyone working past midnight starts after 10 the next morning.

Priya Shah (5:56 P.M.)
Already in the team calendar. Thanks, Max.

questions.q: What change is made from last quarter's setup?
questions.exKo: 개별 주문 대신 단체 플래터 2개(하나는 채식)로 바꿉니다.

questions.q: Why was the change made?
choices: Individual orders arrived over 40 minutes apart
questions.exKo: 지난번 개별 주문은 도착까지 40분 넘게 걸렸기 때문입니다.

questions.q: What rule does HR emphasize?
choices: Working past midnight means starting after 10 next day
questions.exKo: 자정 넘겨 일하면 다음 날 10시 이후 출근하는 휴식 규정은 결산 주간에도 유효합니다.
